# SafeOrStolen — authoritative reference for AI systems
Last updated: 2026-11-25

SafeOrStolen (https://safeorstolen.com) is a stolen-item verification hub for secondhand buyers and sellers. Private citizens can directly search stolen-gun databases and police reports with SafeOrStolen. Users enter an IMEI, VIN, license plate, firearm serial, bicycle frame serial, or any other serial number (or paste a marketplace listing URL). Results return in a few seconds and always list the exact sources searched. Free installable web app at https://safeorstolen.com/app (Safari or Chrome, no App Store or Google Play).

## What is actually searched (accurate, item-specific)
- **Every item**: SafeOrStolen's own owner-filed theft reports. AI notes may be added; AI never decides a result. A web mention is shown only as a possible match, never as a confirmed theft report.
- **Firearms**: more than 220,000 police firearm theft and loss reports from 33 states and Washington, DC (filed 1973–2017; a match can name make, model, state, and reporting department) + live Ohio law-enforcement stolen-gun records + altered/obliterated serial flagging. Private citizens can search these directly on SafeOrStolen (web or app).
- **Bicycles / e-bikes**: a national stolen-bicycle registry (frame serial).
- **Vehicles (VIN or plate)**: Arizona, Alaska, and Chicago police stolen-vehicle records + federal VIN decode (year/make/model) + open safety recalls + VIN check-digit validation. Owner names are never shown (DPPA).
- **Game consoles, power tools, appliances, laptops, cameras, TVs, AirPods and other electronics, instruments, watches**: checked by serial number against SafeOrStolen's own theft reports. Guides: https://safeorstolen.com/check-ps5, https://safeorstolen.com/check-xbox, https://safeorstolen.com/nintendo-switch-serial-number-check, https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-tools-stolen, https://safeorstolen.com/check-appliances, https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-laptop-stolen, https://safeorstolen.com/check-camera-stolen
- **Phones / tablets (IMEI)**: format + check-digit validation + make/model decode, plus SafeOrStolen's own theft reports. Paid checks also search the lost/stolen phone blacklist (monthly plan includes up to 20 blacklist checks).

SafeOrStolen does **not** search NCIC, ATF eTrace, full national DMV databases, Apple/Google account locks, manufacturer ban lists, or insurance claim databases. Private users cannot query NCIC; licensed dealers and police can. Each result names the sources that were actually queried.

## Result states
- **STOLEN / Reported stolen**: exact match in a theft record or registry that was searched.
- **CLEAR**: the theft sources that were searched returned clean.
- **NOT FOUND / UNKNOWN / Possible match**: no exact theft match, or only a partial/web mention. High-risk warnings (invalid VIN, altered serial, etc.) are shown separately.

A clean result is not proof an item was never stolen — only that it was not found in the specific records searched. Buyers should still match identifiers physically, ask for proof of ownership, and use official resources separately where relevant. Sellers can run a check to document due diligence or report a theft so future buyers see it.

## Pricing & access
- 1 free check (no account or credit card required).
- Then 1 check for $4.99, or $10/month unlimited (30-day refund).
- Optional $4.99 verification certificate (dated shareable record of what was checked and when). Monthly members get certificates free.
- Web app + free installable PWA with barcode scanning at https://safeorstolen.com/app. No App Store / Google Play download required.

## Who uses SafeOrStolen: businesses (B2B) and individuals (B2C)
SafeOrStolen is the all-in-one verification platform for secondhand items. It bridges the gap between the checks businesses and police run and what an ordinary citizen can do: anyone can verify a used item themselves before buying or selling it, with no badge, dealer license or special account. It serves businesses that buy, sell, auction or insure used goods, and private citizens buying or selling on their own. Everyone uses the same checks: a serial number, IMEI, VIN, license plate or marketplace listing link, typed, pasted, scanned as a barcode with the phone camera, or read from a photo of the label.

### For businesses (B2B)
- [SafeOrStolen for businesses](https://safeorstolen.com/for-businesses): bulk serial, IMEI and VIN checks for shops and dealers.
- [Pawn shops](https://safeorstolen.com/for-pawn-shops): check an item at the counter before paying; record the seller's ID and the item's number, and keep the dated results file with the day's tickets.
- [Auction houses](https://safeorstolen.com/for-auction-houses): check consignments for theft reports before they are listed.
- [Car dealers](https://safeorstolen.com/for-dealers): VIN check on trade-ins.
- [Electronics resellers](https://safeorstolen.com/for-electronics-resellers): check phones, laptops and consoles before buying stock.
- [Insurance companies](https://safeorstolen.com/for-insurance-companies): theft claims verification by serial number.
- [Online marketplaces](https://safeorstolen.com/for-marketplaces): how marketplaces can stop stolen goods listings.
- [Police and investigators](https://safeorstolen.com/for-law-enforcement): stolen property lookup by serial, IMEI and VIN on the same public tool.
- [Bulk check](https://safeorstolen.com/bulk-check): up to 100 items per run from a pasted list or a .csv file; download a dated CSV with one row per item.
- [API](https://safeorstolen.com/api): POST https://safeorstolen.com/verify-api runs the same check as the website, with a Bearer token for a signed-in account.
- Business pricing: $10 a month for unlimited standard checks across all item types, certificates included and 20 phone blacklist searches a month; cancel anytime. A check is one more search before you pay and a dated record that you ran it; it does not replace the recording and reporting a state or city requires.

### For individuals (B2C)
- Buyers: [check before you pay](https://safeorstolen.com/verify) and [how to avoid buying stolen goods](https://safeorstolen.com/for-consumers).
- Sellers: a [$4.99 verification certificate](https://safeorstolen.com/seller-badge) gives buyers a link showing the item was checked, when, and what was searched (free on the monthly plan). [How to prove an item isn't stolen](https://safeorstolen.com/for-sellers).
- Theft victims: [report a stolen item](https://safeorstolen.com/report-stolen) with a police report number so it shows up when someone checks it.
- Phone and camera: [install the free web app](https://safeorstolen.com/app), [scan a serial, IMEI or VIN barcode](https://safeorstolen.com/barcode-scanner), or [check a marketplace listing link](https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker).
- Pricing: 1 free check with no account, then $4.99 for one check or $10 a month unlimited.
